_note: units_bounty on mainnet (docs/MAINNET-RUNBOOK.md 'Bounty escrow program'; scripts/mainnet/bounty-init.ts). Public values only. NOT deployed, NOT initialized. Every value under `settings` is an admin-editable onchain setting; the ones filled in are a PROPOSAL of the bounty escrow lane (the values the devnet deployment runs with), not owner decisions. `admin` is the wallet or multisig vault that administers the program after init; `min_amount_units` is the smallest reward in whole $UNITS. Both are null until the owner names them, and `bounty-init.ts send` refuses while any value is null or `owner_confirmed` is false. refund_grace_s must be above the registry's challenge window (3,600 s on mainnet, read 2026-10-13 from GET /v1/challenges/config), or a generation in an epoch posted at the deadline could not be claimed before the refund opens; the script refuses otherwise.
